revision_note: Revision 3 prospectively authorizes one controlled conversion diagnostic on the already-selected checkpoint. It preserves every quality and termination threshold, compares merged PyTorch float16, CTranslate2 float16 and CTranslate2 int8_float16 before using the untouched holdout, and requires every arm and gate to be written immutably as soon as it is measured. int8_float16 remains preferred. CTranslate2 float16 is an authorized non-promotable B4 fallback only if int8_float16 fails and float16 passes the same active quality, termination and executable L4 serving checks. This decision does not assert that quantization caused attempt 4's failure.
precedence: Where this decision conflicts with MedZen Speech Platform Base v5, this owner-approved decision controls B4. Every conflict remains visible below and is never represented as a passing gate.
objective: Reach a working eight-language training path and a verified servable ASR artifact without silently dropping unavailable-data requirements.

code_switch.base_v5_requirement: A real code-switch training and evaluation slice is included and gated.
code_switch.reason: No licensed code-switch data exists in the adopted corpus.

english_french_replay.base_v5_requirement: Use 30-40 percent English/French replay and gate replay regression.
english_french_replay.reason: The adopted v2 corpus has zero English and zero French rows and the owner chose to defer acquiring them.
english_french_replay.consequence: The artifact is not protected against English/French forgetting. Any English/French-facing promotion remains blocked until replay and regression evaluation are added.

lingala.evidence: Checkpoint 500 passed all gates: WER 0.7091 versus base 0.9207, EOS rate 1.0, cap-hit rate 0.0. Checkpoint 600 alone failed.
lingala.selection_rule: Use the existing frozen Lingala/Luganda/Oromo sets only for checkpoint selection.
lingala.holdout_rule: After checkpoint selection, evaluate the selected artifact and same-run base on a larger Lingala set whose speakers and sessions are disjoint from training and selection; prefer a different source/domain when available.
lingala.per_language_outcome: If Lingala fails the untouched holdout while Luganda and Oromo pass, Lingala may be deferred only at the later per-language approval stage. Luganda and Oromo may continue; Lingala remains pinned to the base or previous approved artifact.

checkpoint_selection.rule: Among checkpoints that pass every active hard gate, select the lowest macro WER; an exact tie selects the earlier step. A later hard-gate failure stops training at that boundary but does not erase an earlier passing checkpoint.
checkpoint_selection.limitation: Selection validation is not an untouched holdout. The selected checkpoint remains provisional and non-promotable until the post-selection holdout and post-conversion checks complete.

termination_gate_deviation.reason: The frozen checkpoint-selection sets contain 35 Lingala, 53 Luganda and 35 Oromo rows. Two independently trained checkpoint-100 artifacts with identical learning rate, seed, manifests and 600-step scheduler horizon produced zero versus one Lingala termination failure and different adapter hashes. Requiring zero failures on every small selection set is therefore an unstable model-selection boundary; this amendment tolerates one unique row per language without representing it as perfect termination.
termination_gate_deviation.failure_definition: A unique validation row whose structured generation output either omits EOS or reaches the configured token cap. A row satisfying both conditions is counted once, keyed only by audio_checksum_sha256.
termination_gate_deviation.recurrence_action: Fail at the first later checkpoint where a checksum already failed for that language; execute no subsequent optimization step.
termination_gate_deviation.checksum_reporting: Every checkpoint reports sorted audio SHA-256 checksums and numeric termination flags only; no transcript or audio content is persisted.
termination_gate_deviation.holdout_reason: The untouched Lingala holdout is a separate post-selection approval surface and remains strict; it never selects a checkpoint.
termination_gate_deviation.not_a_quality_claim: The tolerance is a model-selection control, not evidence that the population termination-failure rate is low and not permission to mark EOS or cap-hit gates as perfect.

conversion_diagnostic.evidence_content: aggregate metrics and checksum-only numeric per-row measurements; no transcript, audio, speaker, session or signed URL
conversion_diagnostic.float16_fallback_rule: Allowed only when CTranslate2 int8_float16 fails an active gate, CTranslate2 float16 passes every identical selection and strict post-selection holdout gate, the artifact loads and completes scoring on the authorized g6.xlarge L4 without OOM, and model bytes plus per-language latency are durably reported.
conversion_diagnostic.if_no_ctranslate2_precision_passes: Refuse without publishing a servable artifact; investigate merge/export/runtime or retrain without changing a gate.
conversion_diagnostic.causality_rule: Attempt 4 proves only that the complete int8_float16 serving path failed. Quantization, merge, export and runtime/decoding effects remain separate hypotheses until the three arms are compared.

steps: merge the selected LoRA adapter into the pinned base model
score the merged PyTorch float16 model, CTranslate2 float16 and CTranslate2 int8_float16 on the same frozen selection validation and report arm-to-arm deltas
prefer CTranslate2 int8_float16 when it passes; otherwise allow the owner-approved non-promotable CTranslate2 float16 fallback only under the fixed diagnostic rule
evaluate only the selected converted precision on the untouched Lingala holdout against a same-precision CTranslate2 base
prove interruption and resume from the exact S3 checkpoint using EC2 Spot

revised_b4_exit: checkpoint-selection rule verified locally and in the pinned read-only container
merged CTranslate2 artifact produced at the predeclared selected precision and evaluated after conversion with all three diagnostic arms durably preserved
one fresh gated campaign completed under the aggregate budget with the selection rule declared in advance
every unmeasurable A5 gate recorded individually as DEFERRED or NOT_EVALUATED
